owasp_categories: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

assets.name: Government HR Platform Integration (e.g. Mudad / GOSI)

findings.title: IDOR / Broken object-level authorization — HR Core API
findings.description: HR Core API exposes records by ID (Personal data (PII), National ID / Iqama, Financial data, Credentials / tokens). If ownership is not checked server-side, changing an ID returns another customer's data.

findings.title: Weak session / token lifecycle — HR Core API
findings.description: HR Core API uses jwt tokens; without expiry, rotation and server-side revocation a stolen token stays valid indefinitely.

findings.title: Account takeover via single-factor authentication — HR Core API
findings.description: HR Core API authenticates users with jwt only. Phished, reused or leaked passwords give an attacker full access to Personal data (PII), National ID / Iqama, Financial data, Credentials / tokens.

findings.title: Account takeover via single-factor authentication — Employee Self-Service Portal
findings.description: Employee Self-Service Portal authenticates users with session only. Phished, reused or leaked passwords give an attacker full access to Personal data (PII), Financial data, Credentials / tokens.

findings.title: Credential stuffing / brute force on login and OTP — HR Core API
findings.description: No rate limiting is documented for HR Core API. Automated credential-stuffing or OTP guessing can take over accounts.

findings.title: Credential stuffing / brute force on login and OTP — Employee Self-Service Portal
findings.description: No rate limiting is documented for Employee Self-Service Portal. Automated credential-stuffing or OTP guessing can take over accounts.

findings.title: Cross-site request forgery on cookie-based session — Employee Self-Service Portal
findings.description: Employee Self-Service Portal uses cookie sessions; state-changing requests could be forged from another site.

findings.title: Batch payment / payroll file tampering before upload — Payroll Engine → Bank Payroll SFTP (WPS file)
findings.description: Flow Payroll Engine -> Bank Payroll SFTP (WPS file) transfers a SFTP file with Financial data, National ID / Iqama. Without a signature or checksum generated at source, an insider or compromised host can change IBANs or amounts before the bank / government platform processes it.
owasp_top10: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures

findings.title: Malicious file upload — HR Core API
findings.description: HR Core API accepts file uploads (e.g. documents, images, lab results). Unrestricted uploads enable web shells, malware hosting and stored XSS.

findings.title: Secrets in source code / server env files
findings.description: No secrets manager is documented. Payment-gateway keys, DB passwords and JWT signing keys tend to live in git or .env files.

findings.title: Unauthenticated call across a trust boundary — HR Core API → Payroll Engine
findings.description: Flow HR Core API -> Payroll Engine crosses from 'dmz' to 'internal' without authentication.

findings.title: Unauthenticated access to internal service — Legacy Attendance Terminals
findings.description: Legacy Attendance Terminals accepts connections without authentication. Any foothold in the network can call it directly.

findings.title: Unauthenticated access to internal service — Payroll Engine
findings.description: Payroll Engine accepts connections without authentication. Any foothold in the network can call it directly.

findings.title: Vulnerable third-party libraries (no SCA)
findings.description: No dependency scanning is documented for the custom code (npm/composer/pip/pub). Known-vulnerable packages are a common entry point.

findings.title: Sensitive data sent in cleartext — Legacy Attendance Terminals → HR Core API
findings.description: Flow Legacy Attendance Terminals -> HR Core API uses HTTP and carries Personal data (PII). Anyone on the path (Wi-Fi, ISP, internal network) can read or modify it.

findings.title: Resource exhaustion on public API — HR Core API
findings.description: HR Core API is internet-facing without documented rate limits; scraping or floods can take the service down or inflate cloud bills.

findings.title: Sensitive logs leak data — HR Core API
findings.description: HR Core API logs requests, but log redaction is not documented. Logs become a second, poorly-protected copy of Personal data (PII), National ID / Iqama, Financial data, Credentials / tokens.
owasp_top10: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

findings.title: No audit trail for access to sensitive records — HR Admin Console
findings.description: HR Admin Console processes Personal data (PII), National ID / Iqama, Financial data but no audit logging is documented. Insider misuse or a breach cannot be investigated or proven.
owasp_top10: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

findings.title: Personal data shared with third party beyond need — Bank Payroll SFTP (WPS file)
findings.description: Bank Payroll SFTP (WPS file) receives Financial data, National ID / Iqama. Over-sharing with processors without a DPA creates privacy and regulatory exposure (Egypt PDPL / KSA PDPL).

findings.title: Personal data shared with third party beyond need — Transactional Email (SendGrid)
findings.description: Transactional Email (SendGrid) receives Personal data (PII). Over-sharing with processors without a DPA creates privacy and regulatory exposure (Egypt PDPL / KSA PDPL).

findings.title: SQL / NoSQL injection into backend data store — Payroll Engine
findings.description: Payroll Engine builds queries against a data store and no input-validation / parameterization control is documented.
asvs: V5.3 Output Encoding and Injection Prevention

findings.title: Verbose errors / debug mode in production — HR Core API
findings.description: HR Core API: stack traces and framework debug pages disclose internals and sometimes secrets.

findings.title: Verbose errors / debug mode in production — HR Admin Console
findings.description: HR Admin Console: stack traces and framework debug pages disclose internals and sometimes secrets.

findings.title: Verbose errors / debug mode in production — Employee Self-Service Portal
findings.description: Employee Self-Service Portal: stack traces and framework debug pages disclose internals and sometimes secrets.

findings.title: Over-privileged database account — HR Database
findings.description: HR Database: applications typically connect with owner/DBA rights; any injection becomes full database compromise.

remediation_plan.title: Object-level authorization on every record access (anti-IDOR/BOLA)
remediation_plan.detail: Central policy check that the caller owns / may access the record; use non-guessable IDs; add automated authz tests.

remediation_plan.title: Rate limiting & anti-automation on auth/OTP/sensitive endpoints
remediation_plan.detail: Per-IP and per-account limits at the gateway (e.g. Nginx/Cloudflare) plus progressive delays and CAPTCHA after failures.

remediation_plan.title: Account lockout & credential-stuffing detection
remediation_plan.detail: Temporary lockout, breached-password check (HIBP k-anonymity), alert on spikes of failed logins.

remediation_plan.title: Enforce MFA for privileged and staff accounts
remediation_plan.detail: TOTP / passkeys for admin, doctor, finance and HR roles; SMS OTP only as fallback.

remediation_plan.title: CSRF protection for cookie sessions
remediation_plan.detail: SameSite=Lax/Strict cookies and anti-CSRF tokens on state-changing requests.

remediation_plan.title: Harden session & token lifecycle
remediation_plan.detail: Short-lived access tokens, refresh token rotation, server-side revocation on logout / password change.

remediation_plan.title: Sign / checksum payroll and payment batch files at source
remediation_plan.detail: Generate the WPS/bank file in one service, sign it (or HMAC + maker-checker approval), verify before upload, alert on IBAN changes.

remediation_plan.title: Harden file uploads
remediation_plan.detail: Type/size allow-list, re-encode images, malware scan, store outside web root with random names, serve via signed URLs.

remediation_plan.title: Move secrets to a secrets manager & rotate
remediation_plan.detail: Vault / AWS Secrets Manager / Doppler, no keys in git or .env on servers, secret scanning in CI.

remediation_plan.title: Dependency scanning & patching cadence (SCA)
remediation_plan.detail: Dependabot/Renovate + OSV/Trivy in CI, monthly patch window.

remediation_plan.title: Encrypt all data in transit (TLS 1.2+)
remediation_plan.detail: HTTPS/SFTP/TLS everywhere incl. internal hops carrying sensitive data; HSTS on public sites.

remediation_plan.title: Authenticate service-to-service traffic
remediation_plan.detail: mTLS or signed service tokens between internal services; network policies.

remediation_plan.title: Redact sensitive fields from logs
remediation_plan.detail: Mask national IDs, card data, tokens and medical details in application and gateway logs.

remediation_plan.title: Generic error responses, no stack traces in production
remediation_plan.detail: Global exception handler, debug mode off, correlation IDs instead of details.

remediation_plan.title: Least-privilege database accounts
remediation_plan.detail: Separate read/write accounts per service, no app access with DBA rights, no direct internet exposure.

remediation_plan.title: Data minimization & DPA with third parties
remediation_plan.detail: Send only the fields the provider needs; sign a data-processing agreement (Egypt PDPL 151/2020, KSA PDPL).

remediation_plan.title: Tamper-evident audit log for sensitive actions
remediation_plan.detail: Log who/what/when for access to patient/employee/payment records and admin changes; ship to append-only storage.

remediation_plan.title: Parameterized queries / ORM-only data access
remediation_plan.detail: Ban string-built SQL, add SAST rule (Semgrep) in CI.

remediation_plan.title: Schema-based input validation & allow-listed fields
remediation_plan.detail: Validate every request body against a schema (pydantic/Joi/FormRequest); block mass assignment with explicit DTOs.
